// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.00

|gr1= Mods and Addons

|descr= Returns information about all loaded modifications.

{{Feature|informative|The first 7 values are equal to what is printed in [[Crash Files|RPT]] on game startup in the {{hl|c= ======== mods =======}} category.}}

|s1= [[getLoadedModsInfo]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s in format [modName, modDir, isDefault, isOfficial, origin, hash, hashShort, itemID]:
* modName: [[String]] - user-friendly mod name
* modDir: [[String]] - mod directory name
* isDefault: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] for base DLC, [[false]] for optional
* isOfficial: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] for official content, [[false]] for user-generated content
* origin: [[String]] - either "GAME DIR" or "NOT FOUND" (for the base game or on error)
* hash: [[String]]
* hashShort: [[String]]
* itemID: [[String]] - either DLC appId or Steam Workshop itemID, "0" for the base game

|x1= <sqf>
private _loadedMods = getLoadedModsInfo;
